datagrok_boundary: All three arms cited the target assertion line as #4a, but the source-adjudicated label is base #4. The enforced v15 JSON schema did not allow #4, despite the shared prompt legend addition. This is a schema-constrained unscoreable target, not independent evidence that all three models chose the wrong subtype. Exclude it from valid cross-model strict-recall comparisons.
limitations: One repetition on six selected public clusters is descriptive, not a stable or population effect estimate.
The full arm embeds skill material but executes no scanner, browser, or subagent workflow.
The no-skill arm receives a shared output legend and is not a natural unprompted review.
Other findings were not source-adjudicated; whole-report precision and false-positive rates are unknown.
Input tokens include cached input and are not billing-cost ratios; summed model-call time excludes staging and analysis.
Raw model output remains in a local cache and is not independently replayable from this repository alone.
The enforced output schema omitted base #4, making the DataGrok target unscoreable; the original six-case aggregate is retained as historical output, not a valid six-case accuracy estimate.
